caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular piece of textile laid flat against a neutral, light-colored background. The textile features a woven pattern with recurring geometric designs consisting primarily of blue and white squares and rectangles, forming concentric circular or ripple-like shapes that alternate across the fabric. Interspersed throughout the blue and white pattern are evenly spaced vertical lines of small red dots, which run parallel to each other from the top to the bottom of the textile. The edges of the fabric appear slightly frayed, especially along the bottom margin. The artist's name, "Alois E. Ulrich," is inscribed in small letters at the lower right corner of the image.
title: Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
